Solana Wallet Solflare Goes on High Security Alert Amid Recent Crypto Attacks Solflare co-founder Vidor said the Solana-based crypto wallet has entered a heightened state of security alert following a series of recent security incidents across the crypto industry. The team has restricted access to its infrastructure and code, introduced multiple layers of approval for all changes, and paused new additions. Vidor acknowledged that the measures would slow development but said the team was willing to accept the trade-off. — link

Highlight Clip: CFTC Chair: Binance Hack Once Again Shows Offshore Exchanges Need U.S. Regulation CFTC Chair: Binance Hack Once Again Shows Offshore Exchanges Need U.S. Regulation On December 30, 2026, CFTC Chair Michael Selig said in an interview that the Binance hack highlighted the lack of safeguards at offshore crypto exchanges equivalent to those in U.S. financial markets. He called for an optional federal registration pathway for platforms, requiring them to meet corresponding cybersecurity standards. He said the attack did not target the blockchain itself or on-chain contracts, adding that the traceability of on-chain transactions could also aid regulators. — link

U.S. Bitcoin ETFs Shed $399 Million, Ether Funds Lose $140 Million According to SoSoValue, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $399 million in net outflows on November 2, while Fidelity's FBTC led individual fund inflows with $6.68 million. Spot Ethereum ETFs saw $140 million in net outflows, with Morgan Stanley's Ethereum Trust (MSSE) posting the largest inflow at $3.15 million. Morgan Stanley, one of Wall Street's largest investment banks, launched its Ethereum Trust in July 2026. — link

South Korea mulls raising cold wallet requirement to 99% after Binance hack According to News1, South Korea’s Financial Services Commission is considering raising the minimum cold wallet storage requirement for crypto exchanges from 80% to around 99% following the recent Binance hack. Upbit reportedly holds over 99% of customer assets in cold wallets, compared with roughly 94% at Bithumb and 85% at Coinone. Industry participants warn that stricter requirements could delay withdrawals and increase operational burdens, particularly for smaller exchanges. The proposal remains under discussion and has not been adopted. — link
